description: Alpha-composite one 8-bit channel over a background: fg * a + bg * (255 - a) + 128, divided by 255 with the (t + (t >> 8)) >> 8 approximation (png_composite)
notes: libpng 1.6.44, png_composite macro (png.h), the PNG_READ_COMPOSITE_NODIV_SUPPORTED version, which the default configuration enables (scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt); the result is returned instead of assigned. Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two multiplications (255 - a becomes ~a), adds and the two shifts of the division approximation: 15 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
